summary: Checked bag delayed on arrival in Munich
story: I flew from Columbus to Munich, arriving on August 10, and my checked bag did not arrive with me. I was without it for three days and had to buy a whole set of clothes and shoes to get through the start of my trip, since I had meetings with friends and dinners planned. I spent $412 in total. The receipts and the airline's report are attached. Please process this quickly, as it was a very stressful start to my vacation.
